title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1025 | 女巫摩天轮、袋鼠闯赛道、狗狗大侦探
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🧙 184 个人扮成女巫登上奥兰多 400 英尺高的摩天轮，冲破世界纪录，连佩佩猪都穿女巫装来助阵！
🦘 澳大利亚摩托车比赛上，一只小袋鼠突然蹦上赛道，比赛只好暂停，等它安全蹦走才重新开始！
🐶 苏格兰黑拉布拉多 Sgiath 靠鼻子找出黏糊糊的入侵生物“海呕吐”，拿下年度动物大奖！

📖 Word of the day: sniff（嗅一嗅）

🎮 二选一：跟 184 个女巫一起坐摩天轮，还是看一场小袋鼠蹦上赛道的摩托车比赛？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🧙 184 people dressed as witches rode the 400-foot Orlando Eye and set a world record, with Peppa Pig joining in her own witch costume!
🦘 During a motorbike race in Australia, a wallaby hopped onto the racetrack and the race had to stop until it hopped away safely!
🐶 Sgiath, a black Labrador from Scotland, sniffs out a slimy invader nicknamed "sea vomit" and just won Animal of the Year!

📖 Word of the day: sniff

🎮 Would you rather ride a giant wheel with 184 witches, or watch a motorbike race where a wallaby hops onto the track?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. sniff（嗅一嗅）
to smell something with your nose
例：sniff the flower（闻一闻花香）

2. witch（女巫）
a woman in stories who wears a pointy hat and does magic
例：a witch on a broom（骑扫帚的女巫）

3. costume（服装）
clothes you wear to look like someone or something else
例：a witch costume（女巫服装）

4. cloak（斗篷）
a long loose coat with no sleeves
例：a black cloak（黑色斗篷）

5. wallaby（小袋鼠）
a small animal like a kangaroo that hops on two back legs
例：a wallaby hops onto the track（小袋鼠蹦上赛道）
